column1: # token_hash pairs against a trekr checkout (run from ~/code/lib/rust/trekr).
# DRAFTED BY CLAUDE, NOT YET REVIEWED BY THE OWNER. Verified by reading both
# bodies. Rust's tier is a comment-stripped token stream (DEC-012): it catches
# copy-paste and reformatting, and a single changed token — a renamed local, a
# different bool literal — moves the hash. The distinct rows here probe exactly
# Rust free functions have no owner (DEC-012), so a copied function appears
# twice under ONE id and its pair row names the same id twice: the row asserts
# "the two same-named units collide". See the README for the ambiguity this
# Byte-identical test helper in two integration-test files.
# The one src-tree duplicate in these seven repos: the same namespace check in
# Three constructors, identical but for which bool field is true. One literal
# is one token, so they must not collide — the tier's sharpest negative.
